content_of_post_to_comment: I wish it was socially acceptable to ask how people afford things. Your house is so nice, you go out to eat three times a week, and you’re always on holiday. Are you in debt?
comment: There’s also a hidden difference between affordability and financial health. Someone can afford a lifestyle through income, inheritance, debt, or sacrifice elsewhere. Maybe the harder question is what trade-offs are invisible behind the things we see.
